maml:description.maml:para: Finds airports for a place name, city or code, as Google Flights' own airport box does, e.g. 'Denver', 'Paris' or 'SEA'.

Finds airports for a place name, city or code, as Google Flights' own airport box does, e.g. 'Denver', 'Paris' or 'SEA'. Returns each matching place with its airports' IATA codes, to use in the other tools. Answers are cached for about 12 minutes; set verify to true when the user asks to verify, confirm, double-check or refresh.

Searches Google Flights for one-way, round-trip or multi-city flights and lists the options for the first leg, with prices, times, stops, layovers and airlines.

Searches Google Flights for one-way, round-trip or multi-city flights and lists the options for the first leg, with prices, times, stops, layovers and airlines. A round trip's or multi-city trip's prices are for the whole trip. Each option has a selection: pass it to get_return_flights (Get-FlightReturn) for the next leg, or, once every leg is chosen, to get_booking_options (Get-FlightBookingOption). Airports are three-letter IATA codes; look them up first with lookup_airport (Find-Airport). Answers are cached for about 12 minutes; set verify to true when the user asks to verify, confirm, double-check or refresh.
Departure airport: a three-letter IATA code such as SEA.
Arrival airport: a three-letter IATA code such as DEN.
Departure date, yyyy-MM-dd.

Most stops allowed: any (default), nonstop, one or two.
Only these airlines: IATA codes such as DL or AS. Find codes with lookup_airline (Get-Airline).
Only these alliances: oneworld, skyteam or star_alliance.

Lists the lowest price for each departure date in a range, for a one-way or round trip. A round trip keeps trip_length_days fixed, or, given return_date_from and return_date_to, prices every departure-by-return pair. Use it to find the cheapest dates before searching.
